summary: Validated update (valid; effects: source s-preaccept-unmarshal created, interpretation source_ids, rationale and limitations updated). It tightens the last caveat on the empty-command account by inspection instead of conjecture: the claim that a wire slice carrying no commands still arrives non-nil rested on the PrepareReply decoder plus the generated Marshal/Unmarshal shape, and reading the file shows the same run-time allocation in a second decoder - PreAccept.Unmarshal allocates with make([]state.Command, alen1) at epaxos/defs.go:362-366, exactly as PrepareReply.Unmarshal does at 227-231. That range is now a registered source attached to the account, and the limitation states which two decoders were inspected and that the remaining decoders in the file were not. No measurement, statement or other citation changed. I also verified that the working harness draft is byte-identical to the frozen basis of the last fixed experiment and to its scratch copy, so no drift exists for a future revision to build on. Run state: six questions with explained dispositions on eleven receipts - the fabricated-self-ballot value adoption up to a completed contradiction of a live replica's committed value; the equal-ballot empty-slice replacement decided by the reply adopted at the slow-quorum trigger position, over all six permutations of the three-reply set and four orders of a two-carrier/two-empty set, final because only N - SlowQuorumSize replies can follow; the status-guard stall cleared only by the executor's retry; recovery authority bounded by the recoverer's fixed ballot with no repair on the rejection path; the client-completion contract holding for the single-NOOP case but not the empty batch; and the wrong-row write in handlePreAccept refuted as unreachable. Seven registered source materials now cover the recovery, executor and decoder paths, both facts and all behaviour entries are mutually consistent, and the captured snapshot is untouched.
